heroSubtitle: Control your home from anywhere with cutting-edge technology
servicesSectionTitle: Automation and Domotics Solutions for Every Space
serviceIoTDescription: VITREA: Our home brand to simplify your life. Automating means: Comfort, luxury, and security tailored to you. Control your systems remotely, by voice commands, facial recognition. Whatever you decide with a single touch.
serviceAccessControlDescription: Systems for door opening by fingerprint, code, NFC, registering each access, local or remote opening.
serviceSmartGatesDescription: We install and integrate electric gate systems and connect them to your wireless network so you have local and off-home control, openings by remote command and voice commands. We support you from planning design to programming the entire system.
serviceSmartFilmDescription: We are representatives of HoHofilm: The protective window film that gives you what you need in each environment based on use or requirement. Reduces 94% UV, up to 96% transparency, and 84% noise. With state-change technology for privacy and comfort.
serviceACDescription: We develop projects for comfort air, precision, packaged type, rooftop type, split, among others. We guarantee the climate control of your home, office, business, data center, or any environment you want to have comfort and air quality.
serviceCamerasDescription: Eufy security, a brand we represent for wireless security solutions. With cameras with solar panel option, internal rechargeable batteries, and Wi-Fi or 4G chip connectivity, local and/or remote management with up to 4K resolution. Interactive cameras that integrate with access control, alarm systems, etc., forming a complete security system.
serviceLightingDescription: Control light intensity, combine different colors, schedule lights to turn off when not in use, or ask Alexa to do it for you. Create scenarios for different ambiance needs. Take advantage of a light play for different activities.
serviceNetworksDescription: We work hand in hand with Eero to create mesh wireless networks. We support wireless network studies and install high-efficiency equipment so that your Browse is not affected when connecting to each smart device. These devices manage parental control to help you manage what your children see on the internet today.
serviceProfessionalAudioDescription: Audio systems designed for environments where high sound quality is sought. We create home cinemas, zone environments to listen to music in different areas of your home, office, and/or business. We work with different brands.
aboutSectionTitle: Our Process: Design, Advise, and Install Your Smart Home
designFeature: Design: We create your projects based on your tastes and needs, integrating an elegant environment with a fresh and technological atmosphere.
